CustomField.description: The number of days since the last Quote/Order or Task/Event (whichever is more recent)
CustomField.formula: IF( lastActivitydate__c > Last_Quote_Order__c || ISBLANK(Last_Quote_Order__c), TODAY() - lastActivitydate__c, IF( lastActivitydate__c < Last_Quote_Order__c || ISBLANK(lastActivitydate__c), TODAY() - Last_Quote_Order__c, 0))
CustomField.label: Days since last contact
